👻🕷️ Halloween Part I

🎃 New LIMITED-TIME Seasonals!
- Halloween Morphs: Pin-up Angel Dust, Count Husk, and Grim Reaper Adam!
- New Friendship Pair: Old Pal Rosie and Alastor! (amazing Alastor clothing by @W_00F3RZ!)
- Robed Valentino: Synthesize new Robed Valentino morph!

🕸️ Halloween Hunt: Collect the Pumpkins!
- Find all the Pumpkins hidden around the game for a special reward!
- Hint: There are pumpkins across multiple maps…

🥳 More Stuff!
- Moxxie’s Wild Dream on Jukebox, Millie’s Axe prop, Pixel Sky Scrapbook background, and amazing Halloween decorations around the game by @Zioxi!
